steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Photography's history: from daguerreotypes to digital, each technical advance changed what and how photographers could communicate. | Key Fact: Key movements: pictorialism (soft, painterly), straight photography (sharp, unmanipulated), modernism (formal experimentation), postmodernism (conceptual, appropriated). | Key Fact: Photography has enormous social and cultural impact — it shapes how we see the world, from photojournalism to advertising to social media. | Key Fact: Understanding why and how photographers work helps you make more informed, intentional choices in your own practice.
